verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a file-based install model that an agent can run itself without prompts: dropping a SKILL.md folder makes Claude add it to its toolkit, and skills are filesystem artifacts. It also documents programmatic paths: the Skills API for uploading and managing skills, plus Agent SDK and --plugin-dir loading of plugins from local directories. The marketplace path (/plugin marketplace add, /plugin install) is documented only as in-session slash commands, and the probe's one-command install used a third-party npx CLI, which earns no credit here. missing for 10: a documented first-party non-interactive CLI install command for marketplace skills/plugins, explicit headless or no-confirmation install docs, independent corroboration of an agent completing a first-party install end to end.
